name: Beppin Mama Omnibus
source:
Naoki was a regular schoolboy. One day, after reluctantly following his otaku friend around town while not sharing his interest, he spots on a shelf of the game corner an eroge about having sex with your mother.

Normally Naoki wasn't interested in such things, but the idea of "mother sex" awakened a deep lust inside of him he didn't know before...

Simply the word, "mother", aroused an immoral instinct...
translation:
里山直树原本只是一名普通学生。某天，他勉强陪着御宅族朋友在城里闲逛，自己对朋友的爱好却毫无兴趣。来到游戏区后，他在货架上看见一款与母亲性交的成人游戏。

直树平时对这种东西并无兴趣，“母子性爱”这个念头却唤醒了内心深处从未察觉的欲望……

仅仅听见“母亲”二字，就会激起他的悖德本能……
